title.en: Completeness of the laws of one step

statement.en: Under each hypothesis on the family (none, balanced on, running down, closed, or both), some world shows a pattern of one step with its givers exactly where it satisfies the hypothesis's law with its givers, and a run on a family where its passages also chain; capacity adds one law, activity none.
statement.zh: 在家族上的每个假设之下（无、被平衡、耗减、封闭或二者），一步的模式（含给予者）恰在满足该假设带给予者之律时由某个世界显示，一个家族上的运行恰在其通过还前后相接时显示；容量添一条规律，活动不添。

laws.en: What the step from t shows of a condition is its passage: its level before and after the step, and what the relata taking part take from it and give to it. The step shows a pattern on a family: its members' passages in order, the number of relata taking from it, and whether something taking part takes from or gives to some condition.
laws.zh: 从 t 起的一步在一个条件处所显示的是它的通过：步前与步后的水平，以及参与者从它取用与给它的量。该步在一个家族上显示一个模式：成员的通过依次排列、从家族取用的关系项个数，以及是否有参与者对某个条件有取或给。

laws.en: Every step satisfies the law of every step: the relata taking from a family number at least one where anything is taken from it and at most what is taken, and something taking part exchanges where anything is taken from or given to the family.
laws.zh: 每一步都满足每步之律：从一个家族取用的关系项，凡有所取时至少一个，且至多为所取之量；凡对家族有取或给，就有参与者交换。

laws.en: A pattern is shown by some world of the spine across some step on some family, the world listing each relatum taking part once, exactly when it satisfies the law of every step; on a family balanced on across the step, exactly when each passage also balances; on a family running down across it, exactly when moreover the family's total falls by at least the number of relata taking from it.
laws.zh: 一个模式恰在满足每步之律时，由脊柱的某个世界跨某一步在某个家族上显示（该世界每个参与者列出一次）；在跨此步被平衡的家族上，恰在每个通过还各自平衡时；在跨此步耗减的家族上，恰在此外家族总量的下降至少为取用者之数时。

laws.en: On a family closed across the step, nothing taking part taking from or giving to a condition outside it, a pattern is shown by some world listing each relatum taking part once exactly when it satisfies the law of every step and nothing exchanges unless something is taken from or given to the family; on a family running down and closed, exactly when it satisfies both laws.
laws.zh: 在跨此步封闭的家族上（参与者不对家族之外的条件取或给），一个模式恰在满足每步之律、且除非对家族有取或给否则无交换时，由某个每个参与者列出一次的世界显示；在耗减且封闭的家族上，恰在两条律都成立时。

laws.en: Given passages and exchange are shown, with some number of takers, by some world listing each relatum taking part once on some family running down across some step, exactly where each passage balances, the total after the step, with one more where anything is taken, is at most the total before, and something exchanges wherever anything is taken or given.
laws.zh: 给定的通过与交换，恰在每个通过平衡、步后总量（凡有所取再加一）不超过步前总量、凡有所取或所给就有交换时，以某个取用者之数，由某个世界（每个参与者列出一次）在跨某步耗减的某个家族上显示。

laws.en: For a hypothesis whose law is exact, with or without the givers in the pattern, a property of patterns that does not tell apart equivalent readings of whether something exchanges holds of what every step shows where the hypothesis holds, each relatum taking part listed once, exactly when it holds of every pattern satisfying the law.
laws.zh: 对其律精确的假设，不论模式是否含给予者：一个不区分“是否有交换”之等价读法的模式性质，在假设成立处（每个参与者列出一次）对每一步所显示者成立，恰在它对满足该律的每个模式成立时。

laws.en: Under each hypothesis (none, balanced on, running down, closed, or both), a run of patterns is shown by some world across every step on one family, the hypothesis holding at every step and each relatum taking part listed once, exactly when its passages follow one another, what stands after each step at each member being what stands before the next, and each step satisfies the hypothesis's law.
laws.zh: 在每个假设（无、被平衡、耗减、封闭或二者）之下：一串模式恰在其通过前后相接（每个成员每步之后所立即下一步之前所立）且每步满足该假设之律时，由某个世界跨每一步在一个家族上显示（假设每步成立，每个参与者列出一次）。

laws.en: For a hypothesis whose law of runs is exact, a property of runs that does not tell apart runs with the same passages and takers and equivalent readings of exchange at every step holds of what every world shows on a family where the hypothesis holds at every step, each relatum taking part listed once, exactly when it holds of every run whose passages follow one another and whose steps satisfy the law.
laws.zh: 对其运行之律精确的假设：一个不区分“每步通过与取用者相同、交换读法等价”之运行的运行性质，在假设每步成立的家族上（每个参与者列出一次）对每个世界所显示者成立，恰在它对通过相接且每步满足该律的每串运行成立时。

laws.en: One construction gives the witnesses: a world of the spine in which a whole relatum takes what unit relata leave and gives all that is given shows, at each step whose passages lead to the next and whose takers are at least one where anything is taken and at most what is taken, the step's pattern, each relatum listed once, something exchanging exactly where anything is taken or given or a chosen outer exchange holds.
laws.zh: 一个构造给出见证：脊柱的一个世界（整体关系项取单位关系项所余并给出全部所给），在通过通向下一步、且取用者凡有所取至少一个且至多为所取之量的每一步，显示该步的模式，每个参与者列出一次；恰在有所取或所给、或所选的外部交换成立时有交换。

laws.en: With the givers counted, every step satisfies the law of the givers: the relata giving to a family number at least one where anything is given to it and at most what is given; where the family is dissipated on across the step, every relatum giving to it takes from it, so the givers are at most the takers.
laws.zh: 计入给予者，每一步都满足给予者之律：给一个家族的关系项，凡有所给时至少一个，且至多为所给之量；家族跨此步被耗散时，每个给它的关系项也从它取用，所以给予者不多于取用者。

laws.en: Under no hypothesis, balance on the family and closure, a pattern with its givers is shown by some world across some step on some family, each relatum taking part listed once, exactly when it satisfies the hypothesis's law and the law of the givers; on a family running down, or running down and closed, exactly when moreover the givers are at most the takers.
laws.zh: 在无假设、被平衡与封闭之下：一个带给予者的模式恰在满足该假设之律与给予者之律时，由某个世界跨某步在某个家族上显示（每个参与者列出一次）；在耗减、或耗减且封闭的家族上，恰在此外给予者不多于取用者时。

laws.en: With each relatum taking part giving the family at most cap across the step, what is given to it is at most cap times the givers; under each hypothesis (none, balanced on, running down, closed, or both) with that capacity, a pattern with its givers is shown by some world listing each relatum once exactly when it satisfies that hypothesis's law with its givers (running down: givers at most takers) and that bound.
laws.zh: 跨此步每个参与者给家族至多 cap 时，所给至多为 cap 乘给予者数；在每个假设（无、被平衡、耗减、封闭或二者）加此容量之下，带给予者的模式恰在满足该假设带给予者之律（耗减时给予者不多于取用者）且满足此界时，由某个每个参与者列出一次的世界显示。

laws.en: With only active relata giving, and only active relata taking and only from what they draw on, across the step, a pattern with its givers is shown by some world listing each relatum taking part once, under each hypothesis (none, balanced on, running down, closed, or both), exactly when it satisfies that hypothesis's law with its givers (running down: givers at most takers), as without activity: activity adds no law.
laws.zh: 跨此步只有活跃者给予、只有活跃者取用且只从其所汲取者取用时，在每个假设（无、被平衡、耗减、封闭或二者）之下，带给予者的模式恰在满足该假设带给予者之律（耗减时给予者不多于取用者）时由某个每个参与者列出一次的世界显示，与不加活动的假设时相同：活动不添规律。

laws.en: Under each hypothesis (none, balanced on, running down, closed, or both), a run of patterns with their givers is shown by some world across every step on one family, the hypothesis holding at every step and each relatum taking part listed once, exactly when its passages follow one another and each step satisfies that hypothesis's law with its givers (running down: givers at most takers).
laws.zh: 在每个假设（无、被平衡、耗减、封闭或二者）之下：一串带给予者的模式恰在其通过前后相接、且每步满足该假设带给予者之律（耗减时给予者不多于取用者）时，由某个世界跨每一步在一个家族上显示（假设每步成立，每个参与者列出一次）。

hypotheses.en: Worlds of the spine, with natural-number levels and amounts; the characterizations count a pattern as shown by a world at a step only where that world lists each relatum taking part in the step once; the law of every step holds of every step without it.
hypotheses.zh: 脊柱的世界，水平与量为自然数；刻画只在一个世界把参与该步的每个关系项列出一次时，才把该步的模式算作由它显示；每步之律不需此条件，对每一步都成立。

hypotheses.en: No premise beyond the hypothesis on the family each law names (none, balanced on, running down, closed, or both, with capacity or activity at the step where stated).
hypotheses.zh: 除各律所述家族上的假设（无、被平衡、耗减、封闭或二者，以及所述之处一步上的容量或活动）外不加前提。

hypotheses.en: The run laws take one family fixed across every step.
hypotheses.zh: 运行之律取跨每一步固定的一个家族。

does_not_show.en: The pattern does not count the active relata, or those taking part without taking or giving: counting them would need a decision of which relata are active.
does_not_show.zh: 模式不计活跃的关系项，也不计参与而不取不给者：计数它们需要判定哪些关系项活跃。

does_not_show.en: Capacity and activity are characterized at one step, not over runs.
does_not_show.zh: 容量与活动只在一步上刻画，不在运行上。

does_not_show.en: The run laws do not cover families chosen afresh at each step, which running down across a step, some family running down there, allows.
does_not_show.zh: 运行之律不涵盖逐步重新选定的家族，而跨一步的耗减（那里某个家族耗减）允许如此。

detail.zh: 所陈述的律允许而没有世界显示的模式（OneStep.stated_not_realized、OneStep.standing_bound_needed）。
detail.en: Patterns the stated laws allow and no world shows (OneStep.stated_not_realized, OneStep.standing_bound_needed).

next_delta.en: Capacity and activity over runs; counting active relata where activity is decided.

correspondence.en: Following Ren's “move towards 100%” of 12 October 2026: completeness in the strong sense, the laws of a kind being all its laws, held before for counting only (tally_iff_counted); here for the laws of one step of Becoming.Locality. An AI reading: with the two laws the stated laws miss added (something taken has a taker; with balance, nothing is taken beyond what stood with what was given), the laws of one step are all of them; across runs on one family the only further law is the continuity of what stands.
correspondence.zh: 按 Ren 2026-10-12 的“move towards 100%”：强意义上的完备，即一类规律是该类的全部规律，此前只对计数成立（tally_iff_counted）；这里对 Locality 的一步之律给出。AI 的读法：加上所陈述之律遗漏的两条（有所取就有取用者；平衡时所取不超过所立加所给），一步之律就是全部；跨一个家族上的运行，唯一多出的律是所立的连续。

detail.zh: 复用 Locality 的 BalancesOn、RunsDownOn、ClosedAt 与所陈述的一步之律；这里证明它们（加两条）是全部。
detail.en: Reuses Locality's BalancesOn, RunsDownOn, ClosedAt and the stated laws of one step; here they are proved, with two more, to be all.

input.en: The completeness of the laws of one step.

detail.zh: 计数的全部规律（tally_iff_counted、counting_laws）的对应：同样以精确刻画与见证世界回答。
detail.en: The counterpart of the whole law of counting (tally_iff_counted, counting_laws): answered the same way, by an exact characterization and a witness world.

output.en: The method of completeness for counting.

history.en: 28 October 2026: migrated to schema 2 (DF3 batch B, study section 441): the statement rewritten from the old one, a run on one family being shown where its passages also chain, as the run laws have it; the claim split into fourteen laws, each read against its declarations in OneStep.lean, Flow.lean, Locality.lean and Space.lean, with the conditions the Lean takes written in (each relatum taking part listed once; a property not telling apart equivalent readings of exchange, or runs alike at every step; the exchange clause of runsDown_passages_iff; the givers at most the takers under running down); the witness narrowed from one world serving every pattern to one construction giving a world for each; the limitations and the second hypothesis to three does-not-show items, two hypotheses and the standard boundaries no-ethical-premise, discrete-steps and names-provisional; one hypothesis added, stating what the model already takes (worlds of the spine with natural-number levels and amounts, a pattern counted as shown only where the world lists each relatum taking part once); process markers cut from the correspondence, its reading labelled an AI reading; Flow.renewers, OneStep.stated_not_realized and OneStep.standing_bound_needed added to their files' references; no premise's content, status, proof binding or source hash changed. Every earlier sentence is mapped in [laws-of-one-step-complete.md](../../../../_process/research/2026-10-05-repository-reconciliation/architecture/df/df3-mapping/laws-of-one-step-complete.md); the exact earlier record is the first text_versions entry. The migration's skeptical review was taken in laws, the statement, hypotheses, each read against the Lean it cites.
